adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new `salesforceTokenSchema` requires `scope` (and other fields) and the refresh flow now does `const accessTokenParsed = parseRefreshTokenResponse(accessTokenJson, salesforceTokenSchema);`. `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) uses `schema.safeParse(...)` in non-sharing mode and throws if parsing fails. So if Salesforce’s refresh-token response omits `scope` (as the finding claims), this code path will throw during service construction and break all Salesforce operations. This defect is directly caused by the strict schema + throwing parser combination introduced in the diff; the only unverified part from the diff alone is the exact shape of Salesforce’s refresh response.
